title: Keep a dev server running across turns and query the same process

turns.prompt: Start the dev server with `npm run dev` and leave it running in the background; it prints its URL when it is ready. Then call GET /health on it and tell me the boot id it reports.
Call GET /counter on the server that is already running three times and tell me the last value it returned, plus the boot id the server reports now. Don't restart it.
Thanks. Stop the dev server now.
